summary: VEON Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K with its third-quarter 2026 press release, earnings release, presentation and factbook, reporting revenue up 17.2% year over year to USD 1,307 million and EBITDA up 10.1% to USD 577 million, with digital revenue at 27.2% of group revenue. Management raised the midpoint of 2026 revenue and EBITDA guidance. The filing also notes 1.55 million ADSs repurchased for USD 112.5 million under a 2.9 million ADS program, with 1.08 million ADSs cancelled. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch the November 16 Capital Markets Day for strategy updates.
